# formal_oauth_client (Resource)

Registers an OAuth client, such as Cursor or Devin, that signs users in to the organization's OAuth-enabled Resources (see `formal_resource_oauth_settings`) with a static client ID instead of a client ID metadata document. Destroying or replacing it revokes every consent and refresh token issued to the client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A public client, such as a desktop app, authenticates with PKCE alone.
resource "formal_oauth_client" "desktop_agent" {
  name = "Desktop agent"
  redirect_uris = [
    "http://127.0.0.1/callback",
    "com.example.agent://oauth/callback",
  ]
}

# A confidential client also authenticates with a Formal-generated secret.
# Change client_secret_rotation_triggers to rotate it.
resource "formal_oauth_client" "cloud_agent" {
  name          = "Cloud agent"
  redirect_uris = ["https://agent.example.com/oauth/callback"]
  confidential  = true

  client_secret_rotation_triggers = {
    rotated_on = "2026-10-15"
  }
}

output "cloud_agent_client_id" {
  value = formal_oauth_client.cloud_agent.id
}

output "cloud_agent_client_secret" {
  value     = formal_oauth_client.cloud_agent.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the client, shown to users on the consent screen.
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Exact redirect URIs the client may use: `https`, `http` on a loopback host (any port), or a private-use scheme containing a period.

### Optional

- `client_secret_rotation_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of values that, when changed, rotates the secret of a confidential client. The old secret stops working immediately; existing grants are kept. Adding the map, for example after an import, or removing it doesn't rotate the secret.
- `confidential` (Boolean) Whether the client is confidential and authenticates with a Formal-generated secret, using `client_secret_basic` or `client_secret_post`. Public clients use PKCE alone. Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret of a confidential client. The API returns it only when the client is created or its secret is rotated, so it is empty after import, and it is not stored when the provider sets `retrieve_sensitive_values = false`.
- `created_at` (String) When the client was created.
- `id` (String) The OAuth `client_id` to configure in the client.
- `updated_at` (String) When the client was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The client secret is only returned at creation or rotation, so client_secret
# is empty after import until the next rotation.
terraform import formal_oauth_client.cloud_agent <client_id>
```
